column1: # One publisher-pinned identity owns each fetched artifact used by a measured
# campaign. Downloaders and measurement runners read this ledger rather than
# duplicating byte counts and digests in separate programs.
# Every remote/download-*.sh language-model or projector artifact has a row
# here, keyed by the model ID its own script or remote/models.tsv names.
# remote/image-artifacts.tsv carries the SD 1.5, SD-Turbo, SDXS-512, and
# LCM-LoRA image-lane files instead: that ledger's component_type, license,
# and fetch_script columns describe what remote/image-models.tsv bundles
# resolve each file into, a claim this six-column schema has no room for, and
# splitting the two ledgers keeps a bundle's component resolution independent
# of a language model's directory-derived install path.
# remote/download-quality-photo.sh pins a Wikimedia fixture through a bare
# URL rather than a HuggingFace repository and revision pair, so it carries no
# row: the source_repository column's owner/name shape has nothing to hold.
